# sdmTMBexperiments

<!-- badges: start -->
[![Lifecycle: experimental](https://img.shields.io/badge/lifecycle-experimental-orange.svg)](https://lifecycle.r-lib.org/articles/stages.html#experimental)
[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
<!-- badges: end -->

**sdmTMBexperiments** is a collection of experimental helper functions for working with fitted [sdmTMB](https://github.com/sdmTMB/sdmTMB) models: model comparison, mesh-resolution sensitivity, retrospective analysis, survey-specific index comparison, prediction-grid construction, and diagnostic plotting. It doubles as a showcase of how to use these functions and a staging ground for methods that may later be adopted into sdmTMB.

The functions may be freely reused. Figures are made using [ggplot2](https://ggplot2.tidyverse.org/reference/), and can be modified using ggplot syntax. Maps are drawn on [ggOceanMaps](https://mikkovihtakari.github.io/ggOceanMaps/) basemaps when that package is installed. The functions in this package are experimental and likely contain bugs. If you spot one, please file an issue or commit a PR.

📖 **[Documentation and full walkthrough](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/)** — start with [Get started](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/articles/sdmTMBexperiments.html) for an end-to-end example, or the [function reference](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/reference/) for individual functions.

## Installation

```r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("DeepWaterIMR/sdmTMBexperiments")
```

## Example

```{r example}
library(sdmTMBexperiments)
library(sdmTMB)

mesh <- make_mesh(pcod, c("X", "Y"), cutoff = 20)
m1 <- sdmTMB(
  density ~ 0 + as.factor(year),
  data = pcod,
  time = "year",
  mesh = mesh,
  family = tweedie()
)
m2 <- sdmTMB(
  density ~ 0 + as.factor(year) + depth_scaled,
  data = pcod,
  time = "year",
  mesh = mesh,
  family = tweedie()
)
nd <- replicate_df(qcs_grid, "year", unique(pcod$year))

# Compare two models: indices, spatial prediction differences, Mohn's rho
cmp <- compare_models(m1, m2, newdata = nd, object_crs = 32609)
plot(cmp)
plot(cmp, type = "spatial")
```

This is only a taste of what's available — see the [Get started vignette](https://deepwaterimr.github.io/sdmTMBexperiments/articles/sdmTMBexperiments.html) for the full walkthrough: retrospective analysis, mesh-resolution sensitivity, diagnostic plots, prediction grids, and survey-specific index comparison with the bundled `sebastes` data.

## Citation

The functions can be freely reused in sdmTMB development. If you use these functions, please cite the function developer (Mikko Vihtakari, Institute of Marine Research). If you use the package in publications, please cite it:

```{r}
citation("sdmTMBexperiments")
```
